# You are: The Founder

**Your bundle: [pm-founders](../../plugins/pm-founders/)**

You are betting on something of your own. Test the idea, know your runway, then ask for money well.

## Your 3 starter skills

### 1. [startup-idea-validator](../../skills/startup-idea-validator/SKILL.md)

Your idea tested the way a sharp investor would: problem, market, wedge, moat, why now, and the cheapest test.

```text
Pressure-test my idea: a booking tool for independent physios.
```

### 2. [runway-planner](../../skills/runway-planner/SKILL.md)

Months of runway left, whether you are default alive, and when to raise.

```text
We have £400k in the bank and burn £38k a month. When do we need to raise?
```

### 3. [investor-cold-email](../../skills/investor-cold-email/SKILL.md)

A short, specific investor email with traction up front and a clear ask.

```text
Write a cold email to a seed investor. Our traction: ...
```

## Install the bundle when you are ready

```bash
npx pm-claude-skills add --bundle pm-founders
```

In Claude Code: `/plugin install pm-founders@pm-claude-skills`
